# Claw Family

> The Claw Family is a collection of open-source AI agent frameworks including OpenClaw, PicoClaw, ZeroClaw, ClawHub, and nanobot. This comprehensive guide provides overview, comparisons, and resources for developers working with AI agents.

The Claw Family frameworks share common principles of agent-based AI development while serving different use cases:
- OpenClaw: General-purpose agent framework
- PicoClaw: Lightweight agent framework for resource-constrained environments
- ZeroClaw: Rust-based agent framework focused on performance
- ClawHub: Public skill registry for discovering and sharing agent skills
- nanobot: Lightweight Python AI assistant with skill system

## Overview

- [Claw Family Guide](https://ccagentorg.github.io/claw-family/): Main landing page with animated infographics and framework comparison
- [Framework Comparisons](https://ccagentorg.github.io/claw-family/#frameworks): Side-by-side comparison of all Claw Family frameworks
- [Getting Started](https://ccagentorg.github.io/claw-family/#getting-started): Quick start guides for each framework

## Documentation

- [OpenClaw Documentation](https://github.com/anomalyco/OpenClaw): General-purpose agent framework docs
- [PicoClaw Documentation](https://github.com/anomalyco/PicoClaw): Lightweight framework documentation
- [ZeroClaw Documentation](https://github.com/CCAgentOrg/zeroclaw): Rust agent framework
- [nanobot Documentation](https://github.com/nanobot-ai/nanobot): Python AI assistant
